intro: Convert km into miles per hour accurately for highway driving limits, imported vehicle speedometers, and race track speeds. Because 1 statute mile equals exactly 1.609344 km, 1 kilometer per hour equals 0.62137119 miles per hour. Whether you need a quick conversion for kilometers to miles per hour on European road signs, want to check how fast a speed reading is in mph, or are browsing our kilometers to miles per hour conversion table below, every figure uses the exact international factor.
alsoWrittenAs: km per hour to miles per hour, kph to mph, km/hr to mph, kilometres per hour to mph

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact Factor vs. Mental 0.6 Shortcut
items: The exact conversion between km/h and mph is defined by 1 statute mile = 1.609344 km (so 1 km/h = 1 ÷ 1.609344 ≈ 0.62137119 mph).
Multiplying by 0.6 in your head underestimates speed by ~3.4% (3.4 mph low at 100 km/h and over 10 mph low at 300 km/h). Use 0.62137119 for precision.

faqs.question: How do I convert km into mph?
faqs.answer: Divide kilometers per hour (km/h) by 1.609344, or multiply by 0.62137119. For a quick mental check, multiply by 0.62—so 100 km/h equals 62.14 mph.

faqs.question: How do I change a speedometer from km to mph?
faqs.answer: On most digital car dashboards, open Settings > Units (or Display) and switch speed units from km/h to mph, or hold the steering-wheel/cluster unit toggle button. On older analog gauges, check your owner's manual for a dual-scale dial or use the km/h to mph chart above.

faqs.question: What does km/h mean and how fast is 1 km/h in mph?
faqs.answer: km/h stands for kilometers per hour—the distance in kilometers traveled in one hour. One km/h equals 0.62137119 miles per hour (roughly 0.62 mph).

faqs.question: What is 100 km/h in mph?
faqs.answer: 100 km/h equals 62.13712 mph (about 62.1 mph), computed using the exact 1.609344 divisor.
